long_biography.plain_text:
Rick Carter worked in Gulfport's clothing trade before joining longtime friend Terry Green and slot-machine entrepreneur Si Redd in a speculative gambling-cruise venture. Their Pride of Mississippi carried passengers into international waters, and Carter helped press for legal casino cruising along the coast. The operation evolved into Copa Casino, establishing Carter and Green as early operators in Mississippi gaming.

Hurricane Katrina destroyed the Copa in 2005. Rather than leave the market, Carter and Green acquired the former Grand Casino Gulfport site and opened Island View Casino Resort the following year. They subsequently added hotel, gaming and leisure capacity while retaining private ownership through Gulfside Casino Partnership. Carter remains a principal of the partnership, while professional executives oversee daily resort operations. He and Green entered the Mississippi Gaming Hall of Fame together.
